_meta.description: Assumptions for the parametric FinOps model of enterprise agentic-AI platforms on Microsoft Azure. Indicative list prices, no discounts, no taxes. Replace them with your own contract (EA/MCA/CSP) prices, region and workload data before making decisions.
_meta.model: monthly_tco(Q) = F[arch][profile] x region_index x region_multiplier + Q x (ai_per_query[query_profile] x deployment_factor x (1 - ai_optimization) + platform_variable[arch] x region_index) + steps(Q) + ops_fte[arch](agents) x fte_cost + build_one_off / amortization_months

currency._comment: Exchange rate used to show every figure in EUR and USD. Azure publishes list prices in USD and derives local-currency prices; check the rate applied in your agreement.

regions._comment: Indicative infrastructure price index relative to Spain Central (= 1.00), blended across compute, PaaS, networking and storage SKUs. AI model token prices are NOT region-indexed: they depend on the deployment type (global, data zone, regional). Always verify service and model availability per region.

spaincentral.name: Spain Central (Madrid)
spaincentral.paired: None (availability zones; cross-region DR to France Central or West Europe)

ai_deployment_types._comment: Assumed token-price factor relative to a Data Zone deployment. Global routes inference to any Azure geography (cheapest, weakest residency); Data Zone keeps processing inside the EU or US data zone; Regional keeps it in a single region.

A.name: Pure serverless
A.stack: Azure Functions Flex Consumption + Durable Functions + queues

B.name: Managed agentic platform
B.stack: Microsoft Foundry (Agent Service, Model Router, Evaluations, Guardrails) + deterministic Functions

C.name: Managed Kubernetes
C.stack: AKS Automatic + Gateway API + Kafka/Event Hubs + operators

D.name: Container PaaS with enterprise integration
D.stack: Azure Container Apps + Service Bus Premium + API Management Standard v2

P1.name: Essential
P1.description: 2 environments (DEV + PRO), public endpoints protected by corporate identity and basic WAF, no HSM, no WORM. Internal, non-sensitive data.

P2.name: Standard
P2.description: 3 environments (DEV + PRE + PRO), private networking and Private Endpoints in PRO only, Key Vault Standard, Front Door Standard. Low-risk personal data.

P3.name: Regulated
P3.description: 3 environments with 100% private-network parity, Key Vault Premium (HSM), customer-managed keys, WORM storage, Front Door Premium + WAF. Personal or regulated data, reinforced audit.

light.name: FAQ / light RAG
light.description: ~3-4k input tokens, ~0.4k output tokens, small model, frequent cache hits

standard.name: RAG with verification
standard.description: ~8k input tokens, ~1k output tokens, model mix, content safety + PII detection + embeddings

agentic.name: Multi-step agentic
agentic.description: ~30-60k cumulative tokens, 3-8 tool calls, frontier model for planning

volume_steps.reason: AI Search S1 in PRO + General Purpose database tier
Additional search replicas, database capacity and observability
Search partitions, state sharding and trace retention at scale

people._comment: Fully loaded monthly cost of one platform engineer. Typical ranges: 4,500-7,500 EUR in Southern/Eastern Europe, 7,000-10,000 EUR in Northern/Western Europe, 11,000-16,000 USD in the US.

shared_services._comment: Corporate services already paid for (sunk cost). Their cost is removed from the architecture's fixed cost; allocate them through showback.
